GOAL: Produce a comprehensive PRD for PR Auto-Remediation V2.0, a mention-triggered, headless, on-prem PR remediation bot, derived from the force-bound merged-requirements spec.
WHY: Document the requirements for a headless, on-prem PR remediation bot in which an authorized collaborator @-mentions the bot on a PR review comment, a Dispatcher daemon authorizes and claims the trigger, and a sandboxed one-shot Runner executes /sc:troubleshoot on the parent comment — with propose-only-by-default autonomy, prompt-injection containment, two-phase loop-safety, and fork-only gh — so the system can be designed and built from a single authoritative specification.
